resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com say three platform towers; Idaho Fire Lookouts, Forest Lookouts and the Forest Service list say two. The story reports the split and does not pick one.

FFLOS says burned in 1956; firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts and the Forest Service list say destroyed in 1957. Idaho Fire Lookouts also says 1957 (quote not used because of its dash). The story gives 1957 as the majority date and mentions the 1956 claim.

FFLOS and firelookout.com put the tower one mile west of the cabin site; Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts put it one mile east. The Forest Service list also reads east in its Blacktail row, but that row's layout is hard to parse. The story reports the disagreement.
Four sources give a 30-foot pole; one Forest Service list entry reads 20-foot pole. The story and height_m use 30 feet.

notes_for_editor: Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts both draw on Ray Kresek's book, so they are not independent confirmation of each other. Elevation differs: FFLOS 2,074 m (6,806 ft); firelookout.com 7,003 and 6,820 ft; Idaho Fire Lookouts 7,003 ft. The record's 2074.5 m matches FFLOS and was not changed. The Forest Service Nez Perce list has an abandoned 1950 entry on the Blacktail row whose column alignment is unclear, so it is not used. Access today unknown; only the hike-in label is recorded.
